key_insight: GDSW-type coarse spaces enable scalable high-order 3D domain decomposition, but VEM requires moment-based kernel representations to preserve coarse-level effectiveness for polynomial degrees k≥3.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners support parallel solution of large 3D Poisson and linear-elasticity systems using high-order FEM and VEM.
method: Use two-level overlapping additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW, GDSW*, and RGDSW coarse spaces.
Represent operator kernels through face moments when constructing VEM coarse basis functions.
Evaluate FEM and VEM on hexahedral meshes, with additional polyhedral tests for VEM.
evidence_signal: Tests reached polynomial degree k=5 and 4,096 subdomains and parallel cores, showing scalable Poisson iteration counts across all coarse-space variants and extension of the moment-based construction to linear elasticity.
watch_item: VEM coarse-space construction is not purely algebraic: omitting the face-moment correction makes the coarse level ineffective for k≥3.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 3D
